about_the_game:
A “live-in life simulation” where you can spend time under one roof with the heroine and freely interact with her.

Lily” is your maid and spends her days and nights with you.

Enjoy your life in the “city” as you run the store with her and deepen your friendship with her.

■Story

The long war is over and knights and mercenaries are out of work.

You are living quietly in a tavern left by your grandfather when a girl comes to live with you.

Your carefree retirement comes to an end,

Your carefree retirement is over, and you and Lily begin a busy life together, working together to make the tavern a lively place. ......

■Life with Lily

You can communicate and have skinship with the heroine inside the bar and in the bedroom.

You can choose various actions such as stroking her with touch actions or inviting her to do naughty things.

■Bar management

Create original menus by cooking ingredients obtained from stores in town or in the suburbs.

The prepared menus and equipment will change the management status of the bar and the player status.

■Fun interaction part

You can freely have sex with Lily by using the “Fureai” command and touch actions.

Lily will forgive you more and more depending on your actions.

Changing Lily's clothes

Lily's hairstyle and outfit can be changed individually for her “work clothes” and “night clothes”.

You can get various parts of “bangs, back hair, headdress, costume, and underwear”.
